memories.summary: Hunted and killed a large wolf variant. Dragged it back. Butchered it with Elena. Ate its heart raw.
Raw heart caused intense fever. Woke with enhanced senses (smell, hearing, vision), denser strength, thicker hair on arms/shoulders, harder nails, faster minor healing. Still a goblin.
Wolf variant pelt scraped and set to dry in the clearing for use as a heavy blanket.
